name: sk3: new part, sketch on Top
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); await m.run('sketch'); document.querySelector('[data-pm="sketchOn:top"]').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: sk3: chamfer page offers equal / distance-distance / angle-distance; angle-distance 4 mm at 30° cuts 4 and 4·tan30° off a right corner
sk3: Offset opens its page; a closed rectangle offsets outward 3 mm as one closed chain (picking one line, chain on)
sk3: both directions with arc caps round an open line make a closed slot (2 lines + 2 arcs), base made construction
sk3: Repair Sketch lists the problems of a badly drawn rectangle and fixes it into one closed profile
sk3: Dynamic Mirror about a selected centerline copies what a drawing tool makes, sharing the point on the axis
sk3: an over-defined rectangle lists the conflicting dimensions; making one driven solves it
sk3: a distance between circles can measure to their nearest / farthest points; baseline dimensions from a base line
sk3: Auto Trace turns a sketch picture (a plate with a round hole) into a closed profile with its hole
sk3: Style Spline: pick degree 5, six clicks make one Bézier through the first and last; its control polygon shows
sk3: a selected spline shows its curvature comb; a tangent handle on a point turns the curve there
sk3: a path sketch on Top and a profile sketch on Right; the profile's point pierces the path (PropertyManager list) and follows it
sk3: a part with a lying cylinder and a holed plate (OpenSCAD), a sketch on Top
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openContent('body.scad', 'translate([0,0,10]) rotate([0,90,0]) cylinder(r = 5, h = 30, $fn = 64);\ndifference() { translate([40,-10,0]) cube([20,20,5]); translate([50,0,-1]) cylinder(r = 3, h = 7, $fn = 48); }\n'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !m.active()?.features?.some((f) => f.type === 'openscad'); i++) await sleep(200); await sleep(500); await m.run('sketch'); document.querySelector('[data-pm="sketchOn:top"]').click(); await sleep(600); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()
